name: Misaki Atsuko
source:
As a child, she was sickly and weak, and promised to marry Yusuke on her sickbed.

Since she no longer has a trace of the sickly look she once had, Yusuke does not realize that she is his childhood friend until she tells him. She is a manly and dynamic person who is not afraid to expose her skin in front of men because of her job. However, he is actually a bit clueless when it comes to the opposite sex.

She is currently a budding gravure idol. She is the lead actress in a drama series for which Yuusuke is the assistant director.
